product.name: Production MCP Server Kit
product.description:
Every MCP tutorial shows you how to define a tool and return a result. None of them show you what breaks when two sessions hit the same endpoint, your API key leaks through error messages, or the server crashes at 3am with nobody watching.

This kit fills that gap. It comes from running 4+ MCP servers in production: a semantic search engine (Effect-TS + ChromaDB + SQLite fallback), an inter-session message router (SQLite + durable message queues), and utility servers that have survived months of daily use by autonomous agents.

What you get:

2 production server templates:

1. Typed MCP Server (Effect-TS) -- Schema-validated inputs, typed outputs, dependency injection, structured error handling. The gold standard for type-safe MCP development.

2. API Proxy Server -- Wraps external APIs with auth (key from env, never from prompts), in-memory rate limiting, response caching with TTL, and error sanitization that catches leaked API keys.

Plus:

  • Subprocess IPC bridge -- Call Python from TypeScript via stdin/stdout JSON-RPC. No HTTP, no port management, process dies when server dies.
  • Multi-backend fallback -- ChromaDB -> SQLite -> in-memory TF-IDF cascade with health-aware routing
  • Docker deployment -- Multi-stage Dockerfile, Compose config, health checks, resource limits, non-root user
  • 8-chapter guide covering: typed tools, stateful hub patterns, API proxying, subprocess bridges, fallback strategies, Docker deployment, and testing

Production patterns included:

  • Auth middleware: API keys from environment, never exposed to MCP protocol
  • Rate limiting: per-tool, per-minute, with configurable thresholds
  • Response caching: TTL-based with automatic eviction
  • Error sanitization: 5 regex patterns catching OpenAI keys, GitHub PATs, AWS keys, JWTs, Bearer tokens
  • SQLite: WAL mode, prepared statements, busy timeout, connection cleanup
  • Health endpoints: status, pending messages, uptime

Who this is for:

  • Developers building MCP servers that need to run reliably
  • Teams deploying MCP servers to production environments
  • Anyone who's outgrown the basic MCP tutorial examples

Who this is NOT for:

  • Beginners still learning what MCP is (start with the MCP Starter Kit at $24)
  • Projects that only need simple, single-use tools

All templates are TypeScript (Bun/Node compatible). Python bridge included. Docker configs included.
